insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their metafield configurations to ensure they are set up correctly for filtering. This change may break existing queries, so thorough testing is recommended. The `metafield` argument in the `filter` field of the `query` type will now throw an error if the metafield is not configured for filtering.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from GraphQL queries, but they should not notice any significant changes to the user interface.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, reducing the risk of incorrect results. It also encourages developers to configure their metafields correctly, leading to better data consistency.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { id } } } }

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS, GraphQL Admin API, and Events

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The new Printing API (shopify.printing) allows POS UI extensions to print directly to hardware receipt printers, enabling a more seamless customer experience. This feature is available in POS UI Extensions 2026-07. Developers can use the getPrinters() method to discover hardware printers and send documents directly to a connected receipt printer.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Events
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. Additionally, new metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources such as Order, Collection, and InventoryItem, as well as metafield changes on Product, Order, Customer, Collection, and Location.
